# UniqSuite

> Complete NIS2 compliance and implementation platform with an 17-step PDCA pipeline covering assessment, gap analysis, risk management, SoA, policies and audit. EU Directive 2022/2555 .

## Pages

- [Home](/): UniqSuite overview, pipeline, features and pricing.
- [Blog](/blog): Expert articles on NIS2, cybersecurity and compliance by Dr. Sait Yalazay.
- [NIS2 Implementation Bootcamp](/nis2-implementation-bootcamp): 2-day live training to implement NIS2 with the platform.
- [Security](/security): Hosting, encryption, ISO 27001 / SOC 2 / GDPR posture.
- [Contact](/contact): Contact form for sales, support and Enterprise inquiries.
- [Sign in / Register](/auth): Authentication for the UniqSuite tool.
